description.fr-FR: Les lettres de Thérèse (LT 1–266, avec leurs bis, fragments et variantes), de son premier billet à sa marraine de la Visitation, à quatre ans, aux dernières lettres à l’abbé Bellière en août 1897 : à ses sœurs Pauline, Marie, Céline et Léonie, à ses cousines Guérin, à ses deux frères spirituels, les abbés Bellière et Roulland, et à ses sœurs du Carmel. Classées par année d’après la numérotation de l’édition du Centenaire, texte authentique des archives du Carmel de Lisieux.
description.en-US: Thérèse’s letters (LT 1–266, with their bis numbers, fragments and variants), from her first note to her cousins at the age of four to her last letters to Abbé Bellière in August 1897: to her sisters Pauline, Marie, Céline and Léonie, her Guérin cousins, her two spiritual brothers, Abbés Bellière and Roulland, and her sisters in Carmel. Arranged by year following the numbering of the Centenary edition; the authentic text from the archives of the Carmel of Lisieux.
description.pt-BR: As cartas de Teresinha (LT 1–266, com os números bis, fragmentos e variantes), do primeiro bilhete à sua madrinha da Visitação, aos quatro anos, às últimas cartas ao padre Bellière em agosto de 1897: às irmãs Paulina, Maria, Celina e Leônia, às primas Guérin, aos dois irmãos espirituais, os padres Bellière e Roulland, e às irmãs do Carmelo. Organizadas por ano segundo a numeração da edição do Centenário; texto autêntico dos arquivos do Carmelo de Lisieux.

fr-FR.editor: Carmel de Lisieux (Nouvelle Édition du Centenaire)

sources.edition: Archives du Carmel de Lisieux, section Correspondance: the 270 entries titled "LT …" (e.g. /correspondance/lt-247-a-labbe-belliere-21-juin-1897/), read through the site's WordPress REST API (wp-json/wp/v2/correspondance), post body text. The Nouvelle Édition du Centenaire text; words the editors supply in square brackets are kept. The other records of the section (letters to Thérèse and family letters) are not hers and are not included.
sources.description: Thérèse's letters only. Left out: the facsimile images and the links to articles on the site. The title of each chapter is the site's (recipient and date, spelling of the months normalised to lower case). Indented lines of the manuscript are paragraphs; the other line breaks are kept as breaks. Includes the notes by the recipient on the letter where the site prints them (LT 214).
sources.tierEvidence: Thérèse died in 1897; the letters were first published in 1948 and 1972-73 (Lettres, Cerf), so the 25-year right in posthumous works (CPI art. L123-4) ended long ago. The site states no terms (its mentions légales page is empty, checked 2026-11-01); the editors' notes are not part of the post text.
